subject: dat-mnav-two-methodologies

metrics.name: DAT (Digital Asset Treasury) mNAV methodology
metrics.the_problem: Strategy switched headline metric (equity mNAV → enterprise mNAV) mid-drawdown June 2026. Other DATs using different definitions. Sector pricing off inconsistent methodology.
metrics.definition_a: Equity mNAV = (crypto holdings at spot) / (share count × price). Simpler, common in 2024.
metrics.definition_b: Enterprise mNAV = (crypto holdings + cash - liabilities) / (share count × price). Includes balance sheet. Strategy's June 2026 change.
metrics.the_gap: When crypto is up, definitions A and B are similar. When crypto is down, debt service and operating runway matter — and only B captures that.
metrics.csoai_card: Published 'Two mNAVs' methodology note + dual-definition premium/discount table for top 20 DATs
metrics.use_case: Institutional analyst comparing DATs, regulator assessing sector health, journalist writing the recap
metrics.doctrine: Signed methodology note — measurement of what each firm reports, not opinion on which is right

honest_sentence: DAT mNAV methodology: ~$96B sector, Strategy switched headline metric (equity→enterprise mNAV) mid-drawdown June 2026. Two-mNAV methodology note + dual-definition premium/discount table for top 20 DATs. Measurement of what each reports, not opinion.
